Summarise ACE catch by ocean, flag, gear, species and year

sum_ace.Rd

Queries the ACE database and returns total catch (in metric tonnes), summed by ocean, flag, gear, species and year. Any filter left as NULL (the default) is not applied, so all values for that field are included.

Usage

sum_ace(
  ocean = NULL,
  flag = NULL,
  gear = NULL,
  species = NULL,
  year = NULL,
  group_species = FALSE,
  group_flags = FALSE,
  group_gears = FALSE
)

Arguments

ocean

A character vector of ocean codes to filter on (e.g. "WX"), or NULL (default) to include all oceans.

flag

A character vector of flag codes to filter on (e.g. c("ID", "VN")), or NULL (default) to include all flags.

gear

A character vector of gear codes to filter on (e.g. "L" for longline), or NULL (default) to include all gears.

species

A character vector of species codes to filter on (e.g. c("YFT", "SKJ")), or NULL (default) to include all species.

year

A numeric or character vector of years to filter on (e.g. 2024:2025), or NULL (default) to include all years.

group_species

Boolean. If TRUE, return combined catch across all species specified

Value

A tibble::tibble() with columns OCEAN_CODE, FLAG_CODE, GEAR_CODE, SP_CODE, YY and sum_catch_mt, one row per unique combination of ocean, flag, gear, species and year present in the (filtered) data. Note: if any of the grouping arguements (e.g., group_species or group_flags) are set to TRUE, these columns will be omitted from the output tibble.

Details

Assumes FLAG_CODE is a column on ace.A_ACE. If it instead lives on ace.A_ACE_CATCH or another joined table, update the SQL accordingly.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Filter on everything
sum_ace(
  ocean   = "WX",
  flag    = c("ID", "VN"),
  gear    = "L",
  species = c("YFT", "SKJ"),
  year    = 2024:2025
)

# No filters at all — all oceans, flags, gears, species and years
sum_ace()
} # }
